title: Jazzy American Shichimi-Togarashi Rest-Meat Bowl
description: Savory, springy, and festive, this dish combines the warmth of shichimi togarashi with the Mediterranean flavors of rest meat. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or a special occasion.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality extra virgin olive oil

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, shichimi togarashi, minced garlic, and thinly sliced onion.
Place the rest meat in a large baking dish and brush the onion mixture evenly over the top.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the rest meat is cooked through and the onions are caramelized.
While the rest meat is cooking, toss the cherry tomatoes with a pinch of salt and a squeeze of lemon juice in a separate bowl.
To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the rest meat on each plate, followed by a spoonful of mixed greens, halved cherry tomatoes, and a sprinkle of crumbled feta cheese (if using).
Garnish with additional shichimi togarashi and lemon wedges, if desired.
Experiment with different toppings and flavor combinations to make this dish your own.
